arStrings.szText:
You gain {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} Thorns for each enemy trapped by {c_important}Bone Prison{/c}.

When a segment of {c_important}Bone Prison{/c} is destroyed or expires, it deals {c_number}[{SF_33} * 100]%{/c} of your Thorns around itself.

{c_important}Bone Prison{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Bone Prison{/c} forms a Corpse every second and spawns a pool of {c_important}{u}Desecrated Ground{/c}{/u}, dealing {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_DOT}{/c} Corrupting damage.

{c_important}Bone Prison{/c} becomes a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill, casting the prison around you. 

While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|%|]{/c}, but it drains {c_number}[SF_24*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life every second.
{c_important}Bone Prison{/c} reduces your active Cooldowns by {c_number}[SF_10|1|]{/c} seconds for each enemy trapped, up to {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Bone Prison{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} Essence.
{c_important}Bone Prison{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u} for each enemy trapped.
